recommendation: Keep the audit commit as-is. No core follow-up is needed unless a future work group decision changes the DeviceDefinition.classification model.
issue_request: FHIR-27798 was a Published/Persuasive OO change request for R5 asking to change DeviceDefinition.type from 0..1 to 0..* so hybrid devices, such as gateway/sensor devices, can carry multiple distinct types.
initial_application: No commit subject names FHIR-27798, but commit b1671782cb820cad536d9bcfb7747f99544cd085 lists 27798 in its body and changes DeviceDefinition.type max from 1 to *. Later FHIR-29726 history refactored the repeated CodeableConcept into repeated DeviceDefinition.classification with required classification.type, preserving the same semantics.
additional_context: DeviceDefinition is active in source/fhir.ini, and the R5-to-current map records DeviceDefinition.type=@DeviceDefinition.classification.type. Published R5 already has DeviceDefinition.classification 0..* with classification.type 1..1. FHIR-20579 is the earlier duplicate DeviceDefinition.type request resolved by FHIR-27798; FHIR-27797 was the R4 version retracted by the submitter. Community searches found block-vote/minutes evidence and no conflicting later decision.
reconciliation: Published an empty no-change audit commit. The current authoritative source already satisfies the requested repeatability via DeviceDefinition.classification 0..*, with one classification.type CodeableConcept per repetition.
